map.R-ISS 比 ISS 好在哪？: In what way is R-ISS better than ISS?
map.R-ISS 加入 LDH 与高危细胞遗传学，把「同 ISS 但预后不同」的患者分: R-ISS adds LDH and high-risk cytogenetics, separating patients who share the same ISS stage but differ in prognosis, so it stratifies risk more accurately and is one of the mainstream standards for communicating MM prognosis today.
map.1q21 扩增算高危吗？: Does 1q21 amplification count as high risk?
map.1q21 扩增在 Mayo mSMART 等新版中列为中高危，但在经典 R-IS: 1q21 amplification is classed intermediate-high risk in newer systems such as Mayo mSMART, but it is not directly listed as high-risk FISH in the classic R-ISS; if combined with other adverse factors, the overall risk should be graded up, and interpretation follows the center and version used.
